fix.message: The paper-pop-up look module is not used: start from scripts/new-lesson.mjs (a game: /skills/play/learning-game/scripts/new-game.mjs paper-pop-up).
Shiny kit materials break the pop-up look: every piece is matt printed card (look.card, look.flat, look.number).
Own materials break the pop-up look: build every piece as card (look.card / look.flat / look.number), which prints its ink and the pale cut edge.

note.message: No card pieces: build the spreads from look.card outlines on look.vFold / look.box / look.float (references/recipes.md).
No V-fold: the subject of each spread stands on a V-fold across the gutter so it rises as the page turns (references/recipes.md, How a spread is put together).
No page turn: one spread per step; go(n) calls book.turnTo(n) and update calls book.update(time, delta) (references/teaching.md).
book.update(time, delta) is not called in update(): pages never turn and pieces never fold.
No pull tab, flap or wheel: a pop-up shows the change on the spot under the hand (references/teaching.md, section 3).
No paper ribbon: each spread's short line goes on look.ribbon(spread, text), sentences on the panel.
Solid shapes in a pop-up book: everything is flat die-cut card (look.card outlines), depth comes from layers (references/mistakes.md).
